Instructions for Use
Device description: The Cobalt Embolization Coil System is a embolization coil. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 38 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
The Cobalt Embolization Coil System is MR Conditional. A person with the Cobalt Embolization Coil System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Cobalt Embolization Coil System
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 Tesla only
MR Scanner Type Cylindrical
B0 Field Orientation Horizontal
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 1200 Gauss/cm (12 T/m)
Maximum Gradient Slew Rate 150 T/m/s per axis
RF Excitation Circularly Polarized (CP)
RF Transmit Coil Type Any transmit coil may be used
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions Maximum Whole-Body SAR 1.5 W/kg; head averaged SAR of 3.2 W/kg
Scan Duration Limit total active scanning to 15 min.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
